growth_expectations.rationale: Most Districts reported little or no change; activity flat.

inflation_concern.rationale: Nearly all Districts noted tariff-related price increases; moderate growth.

labor_market.rationale: Eleven Districts little or no change; firms hesitant to hire.

credit_conditions.rationale: Lending volumes held steady; slight loosening in some Districts.

policy_uncertainty.rationale: Contacts frequently cited economic uncertainty and tariffs as negative factors.
